name: GW Ranch Waha Gas Pipeline (Pacifico Energy)
monitor_reason: concrete-step leg failed: the only permit (a state air permit) covers the power plant, not the pipeline; no pipeline operator, route, filing or contract found
researcher_notes: No existing row matches this line. Pacifico Energy is developing the off-grid GW Ranch power and data center campus in Pecos County, Texas. A trade news story from January 2026 says the project has several gas connections, including a 15-mile pipeline to the Waha hub, and ties the campus to a hyperscale data center. Other press coverage of the same company announcement mentions a 1 billion cubic feet per day direct line to Waha and a dual pipeline design. The Texas environmental agency air permit covers the power plant only. Searches found no pipeline owner or operator, no route, no Railroad Commission pipeline permit, no easement and no gas contract for this line. It stays on the watch list. If a concrete step appears, stage it as gas, proposed, 15 mi, DataCenter yes, citing the news story. Confidence is low.
